continuity_preferences: keep kick and hat engine stable across most sections
use mute automation as punctuation, not default behavior
rotate stabs and sequence accents for motion

priority_progressions: single-chord modal center with moving stabs
harmonic_devices: short stabs with minor 7th and 9th color
minimal chord movement with strong timbral variation

groove_notes: precise closed hats with small human offset

notes: arrangement should feel mechanical but alive
prefer additive/subtractive layering over chord rewrites
build tension with filter movement and percussive density
